description: This source file defines data classes and functions for calculating Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) metrics in a manufacturing monitoring system. It processes production events and computes availability, performance, quality, and overall OEE for specific runs.

classes.name: OEEInputs
classes.description: Data class representing input parameters for OEE calculations.

classes.name: OEEResult
classes.description: Data class representing the results of OEE calculations.

methods.name: float _safe_ratio(num: float, den: float)
methods.description: Calculates a ratio while avoiding division by zero, returning 0.0 if denominator is non-positive.

methods.name: tuple[int,int] _sum_counts(events: Iterable[Event])
methods.description: Sums good and scrap counts from a collection of production events.

methods.name: int _sum_downtime(events: Iterable[Event])
methods.description: Sums total downtime seconds from downtime events.

methods.name: OEEResult compute_oee_for_run( run: Run, events: Iterable[Event], window_start: Optional[datetime] = None, window_end: Optional[datetime] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates OEE metrics for a given production run and events, optionally within a time window.
